combinations-permutations-copy-pop:

result = []
perms([1, 2, 3], [], result)
assert sorted(result) == sorted(list(p) for p in permutations([1, 2, 3]))
result = []
perms([1], [], result)
assert result == [[1]]
result = []
perms([], [], result)
assert result == [[]]
